Create a production sprite animation KEY POSE SHEET for FINAL FANTASY: THE HUMMING CRYSTAL. This is one action: Kuro casting Dark. References just shown: the small pixel sprite establishes layered violet-black robes, pale slim young woman, very long purple-black hair, brown belt and muted gold cuffs; the ink portrait establishes long lank hair falling partly over hollow eyes. Do not copy ink hatching into sprites.
Transparent background. Eight full-body drawings, exactly 4 columns and 2 rows, evenly spaced in equal cells with generous clear separation. Wide canvas 1536x1024. No text, labels, border, ground shadow, scenery, effect or weapon. Each figure same size, approximately 56 native pixels high as if enlarged 4x, clean stepped pixel clusters, restrained 24-colour 16-bit FFVI/FFRK sprite treatment. Face screen LEFT in every cell, slight three-quarter profile. Same head, hairline, robe construction, cuff, hands and body volume across all eight. Feet planted at same relative bottom baseline per cell. One open hand casts; never a staff. Long hair drifts gently toward screen RIGHT. Main figure fits centre of every cell.
Reading order:
1 settled standing ready, casting arm low, leftward gaze.
2 anticipation, torso bows 2 pixels, elbow draws back near waist, knees barely flex.
3 forearm begins to rise, palm opens toward upper left, head lifts slightly.
4 open palm reaches chest height toward left, fingers clear, elbow uncoils, hair lags right.
5 palm extends fully to left at shoulder height, robe sleeve pulls taut, upright torso, hair lifted by an unnatural breeze.
6 spell release, wrist turns outward and fingers splay, torso leans subtly forward, hair and rear robe hem follow through, feet unchanged.
7 recovery, elbow folds inward and palm lowers to chest, torso returns, hair still lifted.
8 near settled, palm lowers to waist, robe hem and hair settle toward pose1.
Author actual articulated arm/torso/cloth changes, not translated copies. Keep neck and head size consistent; no extra limbs, no tiny inconsistent faces, no jump or forward lunge. Crisp connected dark outer contour, deliberate shading clusters, no antialiasing, gradients or blur. Full transparency. A cohesive eight-key animation sheet, not eight character redesigns.
effect:
Generate one cohesive animation sprite sheet of a dark magic implosion for a 16-bit gothic JRPG, exactly eight effect drawings in a 4 column x 2 row layout on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. No characters, no text, no borders. Canvas1536x1024, identical evenly spaced cells. The magic is an opaque empty black cavity framed by torn folded violet-grey membranes and pale-lilac razor facets, as if air folds into an empty room. Original restrained horror, no eyeball, no pupil, no face, no skull, no rune, no fireball, no rainbow. All effects centred within their cells with ample clear padding.
Reading order: 1 small flattened black seed with thin folded violet rim; 2 oval hollow opens with two curling torn fins; 3 large vertically stretched cavity with substantial jagged folded membrane rim and black centre; 4 fully open irregular vertical cavity, long upper/lower torn fins curl inward and dark wisps fold around its sides; 5 catastrophic inward crush, black centre narrows and angular ivory/violet facets converge, full large silhouette; 6 crushed vertical slit with angular curved broken shell fragments immediately around it; 7 few substantial folded curved fragments curling toward centre; 8 small dark stitch and two thin ragged violet fragments.
Style: strong authored hand-placed pixel-art shapes, stepped contours and dense pixel clusters, a little sparse dithering in broad membrane folds, 16-bit FFVI-era magical horror art. Mostly charcoal black, bruised violet, dusty mauve, restrained grey lilac highlight, no saturated neon. Visible opaque dark centres, transparency outside shapes. No blurred background, no soft bloom baked around the frame, no painted checkerboard, no stage or ground. Each cell’s drawing fits within the central 75 percent of its width/height. Preserve topology and coherent fold direction across stages. This is substantial sculpted magical artwork, not a few thin lines or circles.
